# B-roll lower third over a synthetic presenter

The broll-lower-third recipe: a quiet name and affiliation plate with an accent line, 80 px in from the bottom-left corner and clear of the speaker's face, rendered transparent for any footage.

- Type: B-roll lower third
- Skill: `magnifito-broll`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 6 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/s11-broll-lower-third.mp4`](../videos/s11-broll-lower-third.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> I have a talking-head clip (synthetic here: make it with node make-footage.mjs, presenter right of centre). Add a lower third in the broll-lower-third style for 4.5 seconds, starting after one second: "Mira", "Social media lead, Magnifito". She is a fictional presenter, so record the name and role in claims.json as placeholders. Render it transparent and lay it over the footage, bottom-left, clear of her face. Brand: dark ink plate, cream text, green #8acf31 accent line, Geist from fonts/.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s11-broll-lower-third
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s11-broll-lower-third/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
node make-footage.mjs 6 1180 center
mgvideo render . --codec mov_prores --force
node collect-run.mjs runs work/overlay.mov
ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -itsoffset 1.0 -i work/overlay.mov -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=eof_action=pass:format=auto,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 0:a -t 6 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/broll-lower-third.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/broll-lower-third.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
